title: The Scarlet Letter
author: Nathaniel Hawthorne
summary: In seventeenth-century Puritan Boston, Hester Prynne is made to wear a scarlet letter A for adultery. She refuses to name her child's father while her long-lost husband arrives in town under a false identity.
readIf: you want a short classic about guilt, shame and community judgement.
skipIf: you want an easy, fast narrative, since the style is dense and symbolic.

pairings.reason: A modern dystopia that picks up the same themes of Puritan control over women's bodies.
Another classic about a woman punished by society for an affair, though very different in tone.
